text:
**Failure mode** — Connection failure (expired Login session). The Login **Coop portal (Okta)** had lapsed past the portal's 90-day session limit, so the Okta session was dead before the Run began.

**Where it went wrong** — Step 1 of the AOP, at transcript turn [2]. The first `browser.open` call was redirected to Okta's sign-in page instead of the reports page. The Agent had nothing to fall back on, so at turn [3] it stopped. Step 2 never ran. The AOP also has no branch for "session expired", so the Run ended as failed.

**Evidence**
- Transcript [2]: `Redirected to Okta: "Your session has expired. Sign in again."`
- Context: Login last re-authenticated 94 days ago; the portal enforces 90-day sessions.

The 94 vs 90 day gap accounts for the failure. This is not a platform fault: the error comes from the user's own portal, and it will reproduce until the Login is refreshed. It will also recur every ~90 days.

**Fix** — Re-authenticate the **Coop portal (Okta)** Login in Duvo so it holds a fresh session. To stop it recurring, re-authenticate on a schedule shorter than 90 days (e.g. every 60-75 days).

**Next step** — Re-authenticate the Login in Setup, then Start Work again to confirm the Run reaches Step 2. If you also want the Agent to fail gracefully next time, I can invoke `aop-writer` to add a step 1 branch: "If the browser is redirected to an Okta sign-in page, use **Human in the loop** to ask for re-authentication of the Login, then retry." The re-authentication itself is the fix for this Run; the AOP change is optional hardening.
